status: verified and reported with nonnegative edge-flow representation
title: R6D bounded local auxiliary-spin compression

program_alignment.central_question: Can the public D4 likelihood be represented by a fixed bounded-arity local factor graph before belief propagation is attempted?
program_alignment.upstream_evidence: R6C is exact but enumerates 1068 simple cycles already at paper-normalized L=2
program_alignment.downstream_gate: BP message updates may be implemented only if the local representation matches the exact likelihood matrix

question.research_question: Does one binary auxiliary spin per vertex and charge colour reproduce the closed-component parity multiplier without enumerating simple cycles?
question.smallest_claim: Exactness on the complete primitive fixture and all registered paper-L2 ambiguity probes, plus direct auxiliary-spin summation on a bounded primitive control set.
question.G2_spin: selected edges enforce equal endpoint spins; degree-not-two vertices pin their spin to +1; degree-two vertices contribute the observed same-colour charge exponent; exact but signed because z^q can be negative
question.G2_edge_flow: one binary auxiliary bit per physical edge and colour; unselected edges pin the bit to zero, degree-two vertices impose a local XOR charge constraint, and other vertices contribute nonnegative normalization 2^(-selected_degree/2)
question.G3_component_label: canonical component-label/root auxiliaries, retained only as a fallback if G2_spin fails
question.fork_classification: G2_spin is the cheapest prerequisite because it has binary bounded domains and fixed local arity; G3 is dependent fallback, not a human ranking question

model.per_colour_partition: sum over z_v in {-1,+1}; a selected edge contributes 1[z_u=z_v]; a vertex contributes 1[z_v=+1] when selected degree is not two and z_v^(observed charge) when selected degree is two and the vertex has the chosen colour
model.component_contraction: an open or branched component is pinned and contributes 1; an isolated degree-two closed component contributes 2 for even colour parity and 0 for odd colour parity
model.two_colour_multiplier: product of the blue and green partitions; hence an allowed closed component contributes 4
model.local_weight: flux/degree support times 2^{-number of measured degree-two vertices}
model.terminal: the existing ground-state-relative winding gate remains separate; R6D does not claim to localize the logical-sector test
model.source_boundary: Jing et al. supply Eq. A12 and a nonlocal 2^C reweighting with constraints checked by graph search; the auxiliary-spin compression is a project-derived identity to be independently verified, not a formula attributed to the paper

method_revision.finding: G2_spin is an exact signed tensor network, not a nonnegative probability factor graph, because a charge exponent can contribute -1.
method_revision.correction: retain G2_spin as an independent Fourier-character control and register G2_edge_flow as the BP-compatible nonnegative candidate before claiming the likelihood graph is probabilistic.
method_revision.edge_flow_identity: cut every non-cycle selected component at degree-not-two vertices into maximal degree-two chains. Each chain has two auxiliary assignments and receives total endpoint normalization 1/2, hence contributes one. A pure cycle has two assignments iff its same-colour charge XOR is even and none otherwise.

matrix.primitive_complete: all 49855 compatible candidate-observation pairs from the frozen primitive-size-2 R4.2 catalog, evaluated by analytic contraction and exact oracle
matrix.primitive_explicit_spin_sum: 64 deterministic evenly spaced compatible-pair probes plus explicit vacuum, open, branch, allowed loop, and parity-violating loop controls; enumerate all 2^V spins per colour
matrix.primitive_explicit_edge_flow_sum: the same 69 controls; enumerate all 2^E edge-flow assignments per colour and require nonnegative local-factor contraction to match the exact oracle
matrix.paper_ambiguity: all stored example candidate masks from every R6B ambiguous public record, with even-charge and one-bit parity-violation probes
matrix.complexity_audit: record auxiliary-variable count, factor count, domain size, and maximum arity for primitive and paper-L2 geometries
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; zero BP, correction, LER, threshold, or decoder-performance samples
